notes.title: Caravan Competition & bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hello again.

The Caravan competition is over. Congratulations to the 5 best players.

#1 Folkius ------------------- 1,077,140
#2 kanzaki_shintarou ------ 849,660
#3 VanAlphen -------------- 806,690
#4 oliveirdaniel ------------- 752,910
#5 GalactaRay -------------- 687,480

Thank you all for participating. It was nice to see your runs. :)

The competition leaderboards are now closed and will be kept online until the end of humanity. 
There's a new Caravan leaderboard.


[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

• Fixed enemies counting double kills in some circumstances
• Fixed a wave with an enemy shooting offscreen

notes.title: Bug fix
notes.notes:
• Fixed a bug preventing the achievement "With Love" from being unlocked.
• Added a Restart button (R, L1 or R1) on the pause menu.

notes.title: Halloween Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/cUPVdfN.png[/img]

[h3][b]New permanent mode[/b][/h3]

• Play as a spider
• Use the focus button to move fast
• New RvNovae track playing with Mads OST
• New remix for Watch Out for Snake tracks playing with Crys OST
• Exclusive leaderboards

Leaderboards for this mode are [b]only available until November 20th[/b]. After that period, the leaderboards will be left closed online.

[h3][b]Balance, fixes and optimizations[/b][/h3]

• Fixed a game freeze while dying on hard
• Fixed some enemies shooting before entering the screen
• Drill enemy now has more hp
• Improved Dutch localization
• Analog stick deadzone improved
• Minor bug fixes

Hope you enjoy it!
Thank you again for all the support you’ve shown for us!

notes.title: Update notes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
We've made some balance, fixes and optimizations.
Hope you enjoy it!

• Improved bullet visibility
• V-shot buff (25% more damage)
• Increased Sword range
• Weapon capsule now gives you 5000 extra points (2000 before the update)
• Improved wave algorithm
• Changed white spider behavior
• Improved visual enemy charge animation
• Warning sign now have a new animation and glow
• Add d-pad/analog support 
• Minor enemy hitbox change
• Fixed audio clipping
• Fixed "wide collector" achievement bug
• Fixed multiplier bug
